evidence.M1: Every grounding clause names a specific event/scene and paraphrases material the layer actually contains — e.g. ev-007/sc-020 'Smith lays out Neo's two lives and offers to wipe his record clean in return for Morpheus' matches the layer's interrogation summary.
evidence.M2: The questions are welded to this story's machinery — 'Is it better to know an unbearable reality or live a pleasant illusion?' is anchored to the red/blue pill choice (ev-010) and Cypher's 'impossible steak' (ev-020), not transferable abstractions.
evidence.M3: The dilemma's horns are mutually exclusive and each is costed in events: sacrifice is priced by Neo being 'not the One' so the rescue is 'a wager on a man' (ev-032), and self-preservation is modeled by Cypher's betrayal (ev-020/ev-029) and Morpheus's sacrifice precedent (ev-025).
evidence.M4: The artifact covers the full span from Trinity's opening capture (ev-001) through Neo's awakening and flight (ev-045–047), including secondary arcs like the Sentinel hunt (ev-019/ev-040/ev-046) and Cypher's betrayal (ev-020/ev-029).
evidence.M5: No invented characters, scenes, or outcomes appear; where the layers are ambiguous (e.g. Cypher's fall 'seems to trip, hidden by the gas smoke' in ev-026) the artifact does not sharpen it, and it flags Trinity's silence rather than resolving it.
evidence.M6: The four throughlines genuinely differ on the dilemma: THEY (world logic = cut the loss, ev-031/ev-032/ev-040), I (Neo's faith-wager, ev-032/ev-038), YOU (Morpheus as the sacrifice precedent, ev-025/ev-031/ev-035), and WE (the Neo–Trinity bond overriding survival, ev-032/ev-044) — each anchored in events.

commentary: The artifact is exceptionally well-grounded and internally consistent. Its only notable weakness is the Neo–Trinity relationship arc, which is labeled 'deteriorates' while every cited turning point and the 'what_changes' description show faith hardening into protective, grief-driven loyalty that culminates in the reviving kiss — a clear label/evidence mismatch (M5/M4 note). The 'Meaning vs. pleasure' theme also leans partly on the inferred 'hollow routine of Meta CorTechs' (ev-005) rather than fully demonstrated cost, but it is otherwise supported by Cypher's arc. These are minor against otherwise clean, checkable, story-specific work.
